listings.title: 2002 Sun Tracker Bass Buggy Pontoon
listings.body:
Classic Sun Tracker Bass Buggy 18' pontoon boat with a Merc 40hp 2 stroke oil injected signature bigfoot series. Great outboard always started and pushes this beast pretty quick. Features a white and green exterior. The interior has white vinyl seating with blue accents, including an U-shaped lounge seat, a double seated center console captain's chair, and two front fishing seats.  The green bimini canvas is in poor shape but works and frame is good. The boat sits on a sought after scissors trailer with a new tire along with a spare and the hubs were repacked, and includes a grey storage cover. The decking is solid aluminum with carpeting. I added a new anchor and line and life jackets for 7 and emergency throw and small dry storage box for the registration and paperwork. I also added 2 batteries one for the main (brand new marine) and one for the new fish finder/depth finder I also installed. I bought this at the beginning of the season and got it all legal and had it out a handful of times. Last time I brought it to cabin the cable for the shifter kinked and will need replaced (a 40 dollar part and less than hour of your time, but can be manually shifted with the cable unhooked a quick fix to show all is working ) and the gas tank cap should have a venting cap but I just crack it when its hot and out on the lake and unhook the line to motor when not in use. I also had it professionally gone over and they changed the lower unit oil and inspected the hub and other things and came back a clean bill of health. I'm looking to sell this asap due to a broken leg and financial help! Due to the upcoming season I will be soon winterizing and keeping the cover on as leaves are starting to fall.

(Update - Lowered price to sell, the scissors trailer and motor alone is worth what I'm asking for)

listings.body:
Your looking at boating history right here, a original 1st generation Flyin Flivver stunt boat built in New Prague, MN in 1957. Designed by Dean Hanson and family and tested on Coon lake, MN in the early 1950's this boat started a whole industry of small Flivver boats. This one is one of the first to be built and is extremely rare, it has the glassed in rope handle and transom motor plate with the patent number on it, it is 8' 2" in length and weighs around 120 lbs.. My boat was damaged by a fallen tree last year and it cracked the fiberglass but it is repairable for someone with that skill. Here's some details:

Alumacraft CO17 "Camper" model with the specialized stern for small motors. Maximum weight capacity (~810 lbs)

The Alumacraft CO-17 (often called the CO-17 Camper) is a highly stable 17-foot aluminum canoe designed for both paddling and light motor use. Featuring a "wishbone" or fantail stern, it performs like a standard double-ender on the water but supports a small outboard motor (typically up to 3–4 HP) for fishing and camping.

Specs & Features

Length: 17'

Beam (Width): 37 1/4

Weight: ~85 lbs

Max Capacity: ~810 to 820 lbs

1982 model

Material: Marine-grade heat-treated aluminum

Flotation: Styrofoam-filled end compartments

Performance & Usage

Motor & Paddle: The unique fantail/square-stern hybrid design allows it to track straight and paddle smoothly, while giving you the ability to attach a small trolling motor or outboard for long treks.

Stability: Because it is wider than a traditional wilderness canoe, it offers extreme primary stability, making it excellent for casting, hunting, and calm-water river trips.

Portaging: Due to its weight and width, it is not ideal for extensive portaging (carrying overland) compared to modern, lightweight Kevlar or fiberglass canoes.

listings.body:
For sale is one of the few remaining 1979 Chrysler Cordoba T-top edition vehicles.

This is the last year of the B-Body Chrysler car. Same body as the Dodge Charger and Plymouth Road Runner

Included is an additional rebuilt 318 V-8 and 904 transmission with roughly 10,000 miles on them.

Also included is the "CORDOBA" MN collector plate and registration.

This vehicle was sold and driven in California until I purchased it in the 1990's.  It originally had the hideous light green interior.  I sourced two sets of dark blue leather interior out of other vehicles for this restoration.

It has around 95,000 miles on it.  It has the 360 V-8 California edition with a 904 transmission.  A 1960's era 8-3/4 rear end with Hemi leaf springs was added..

Initially I was planning on restoring it but after a few decades of lacking time, I have decided to let it go to someone else who has more time than I have.

A lot of boxes of parts come with this vehicle including an extra fiberglass front section.  I also have aftermarket parts and additional parts from other Mopar vehicles such as 11 inch drum and 14 inch disc brakes from a 74 Roadrunner.

In addition to the factory aluminum rims that come with the vehicle, also included are Ansen Sprint aluminum wheels in the 15x10 size and 14x6 size, along with sets of factory steel rims ranging from 14x5-1/2 to 15x7.

The car was originally manufactured as a six-cylinder coupe and was subsequently converted to its current 302 V8 configuration. It is not represented as a factory V8 or numbers-matching vehicle.

listings.title: SURVIVOR 1967 PONTIAC GTO
listings.body:
NOTE CAR IS LOCATED IN WINNIPEG MANITOBA CANADA. US FUNDS

Description

Rare Survivor: All-Original, Numbers-Matching 1967 Pontiac GTO Convertible

The Ultimate Collector’s Dream

Opportunities to own a true, unmolested muscle car icon are vanishing. This 1967 Pontiac GTO Convertible is a highly optioned(17 factory options, all-original, rust-free survivor car that has spent its entire life in the Pacific Northwest. Bought brand new in Vancouver, BC, Canada, this vehicle represents a rare chapter of Canadian muscle car history, preserved beautifully for nearly six decades.

Authenticity & Verification

Numbers Matching: Engine, transmission, and rear end are completely factory-original to the car.

Survivor Status: Original sheet metal with absolutely zero rust. No patchy restoration work—just pure, honest factory preservation.

Documentation: Provenance tracing back to its original delivery in Vancouver, BC.

Factory High-Option Specifications

Powertrain: 400 pontiac / Turbo 400 Automatic].

Exterior: Factory Montreal blue with a matching blue power convertible top.

Interior: Highly optioned Parchmentinterior, power driver bucket seat. center console, His & Hers shifter, power steering, power brakes, power windows, power trunk, power antenna, tilt column.

Interior is all original including carpet, door panels and seats.

Steering wheel is absolutely perfect with zero cracks or marks.

Condition Overview

This GTO runs, drives, and sounds exactly as a factory-built wide-track Pontiac should. Because it is a rust-free survivor, the undercarriage, floor pans, and trunk are rock-solid. The body has exceptional factory gaps. There is some minor scratches and a few small dents as its almost 60 years old. This car is unrestored and is an absolute survivor. I do have the original 14 inch rims with the factory PMD deluxe wheel covers that come with the car.

Has the original bias ply spare and factory jack in the trunk.

New cooper cobra 15 inch tires and rally 2 wheels.

Serious inquiries only. Clean title in hand

This car has to be seen to appreciate how truly original and what an absolute survivor.

The 1967 gto is considered the "Great One"

I have spoken to several GTO restoration experts in the US and they have never seen one like this with the options.

This is an absolute goldmine of documentation. Having the GM of Canada build sheet, factory punch card, and detailed option breakdown makes this 1967 GTO Convertible an incredibly high-value car.

Fully authenticated by GM of Canada Vintage Services and PHS (Pontiac Historic Services).

Authenticity & Powertrain

Engine: Numbers-matching, factory-original YS-code 400 cubic inch V8 producing 335 horsepower with 441 lb-ft of torque (10.75:1 compression). Features standard 670 heads and a correct Rochester 4MV Q-Jet carburetor.

Transmission: Factory Turbo Hydra-Matic automatic transmission controlled by the highly desirable floor-mounted Hurst His & Hers dual-gate shifter and full center console.

Rear End: Factory Safe-T-Track heavy-duty differential with a 3.36:1 gear ratio (YG axle code).

Provenance: Complete documentation package including the official GM of Canada specification sheets, factory punch card, and historical registry paperwork.

Factory Options & Specifications

3" downpipes

Turbo timer

RS4 shift knob

Pioneer head unit + factory Bose

interior trim pieces wrapped with gloss carbon fiber

Wheels/tires:

Hartmann Euro Mesh summer setup + 5th spare wheel, plus OEM wheels with winter tires. (9 wheels + tires in total included in sale)

I've maintained the car throughout my ownership and done the majority of the work myself. Oil changed approximately every 5k miles with Mobil 1 0W-40 Euro. Lots of additional maintenance and service history documented.

I'm selling because I simply don't have the time anymore to keep up with a 25-year-old modified car the way I'd like. I've owned it for almost nine years and genuinely love the car. I'd rather see it go to another enthusiast who will enjoy it.

Known issues:

A/C currently doesn't work; compressor is suspected

Fuel level sensor is intermittent

Some smoke on extended closed-throttle deceleration; present since before my ownership, exact cause never definitively diagnosed.  Has never been an issue during my 9 years.

Wideband needs wiring/sensor.

Various dents/dings and some areas of surface rust consistent with age

Runs and drives very strong. Not a show car—it's a well-loved, heavily modified B5 S4 that's been driven and enjoyed.

Clean title. Extensive records.

$7,999 OBO — No trades

If you're looking for a clean, stock B5, this probably isn't it. If you're looking for a K04 6-speed S4 that's already built and ready to rip, come take a look.
